15import logging 

16 

17import torch 

18 

19logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) 

20 

21 

22def is_same_size(self: torch.Tensor, other: torch.Tensor) -> bool: 

23 """Implements ``aten::is_same_size(Tensor self, Tensor other) -> bool``. 

24 

25 Returns whether the two tensors have identical shapes. ``is_same_size`` is 

26 a metadata-only operator: the answer is fully determined by the sizes of 

27 both operands, which the host already knows, and it never depends on 

28 tensor data. ATen's reference implementation likewise compares sizes on 

29 the host, so evaluating the comparison here returns the identical answer 

30 while skipping the staging of the shape vectors to the device, the 

31 reduction kernel launch, and the device-to-host sync of the flag -- 

32 roughly 100us of round-trip overhead per call on GCU. 

33 """ 

34 # The gcu400-specific module is imported by the short name `gcu400.ops.*`, and accuracy_utils.gems_log_prefix 

35 # derives the common prefix "GEMS" from it; log text must match that derivation or engineering cases fail. 

36 logger.debug("GEMS_ENFLAME_GCU400 IS_SAME_SIZE") 

37 

38 if not self.ndim: 

39 return not other.ndim 

40 

41 # torch.Size is a tuple subclass, so this is a plain elementwise sizes 

42 # comparison -- exactly the check ATen performs. 

43 return self.shape == other.shape
